integrity: All displayed sharp constants follow from finite nilpotent resolvent expansion and Gaussian Hermite orthogonality; rational computations supplement rather than replace the uniform proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional exponential-polynomial Berezin sectors in inherited Gaussian L2 only; full infinite-dimensional Gaussian convolution norm not addressed; independent publication priority and external audit not established.
title: Sharp physical-\(L^2\) resolvent poles of Gaussian Berezin exponential-polynomial jets
